title.rendered: Arqaam Capital has been appointed Sole Corporate Access Partner of the 2026 AFCM Annual Conference

content.rendered:
Arqaam Capital has been appointed Sole Corporate Access Partner of the 2026 Arab Federation of Capital Markets (AFCM) Annual Conference — the Arab world’s premier gathering of capital markets leadership — taking place 29-30 September 2026 in Abu Dhabi, alongside the Arab Federation of Capital Markets and Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange

For the first time in the conference’s history, this year’s gathering will feature a dedicated Corporate Access programme. We will design and deliver it — creating a direct, structured, and meaningful channel between global institutional investors and the Arab world’s exchanges and issuers.

Arab markets are at an inflection point. The liquidity is there. The issuers are there. The institutional appetite is there. What has too often been missing is the bridge.

Building that bridge is what we do. And we have never been more motivated to do it.

The Arab world’s capital markets are open. 🌍

View More
